review.note: Retracted in M21: a routine election of the rotativismo, the arranged alternation of Regenerators and Progressives under the constitutional monarchy. Held 17 November 1895; Progressives and Republicans boycotted and the Regenerators took every seat. The cached lead gives the date and the seat count and nothing more, and the atlas holds no event between 1890 and 1910 that this result can be argued to have changed. It could not be wired without inventing the argument.
